description: List the user's OWN listing-message conversations (threads they started, or received as a listing owner), newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever this user's threads. Use get_conversation to read a thread's messages.

limit.description: Maximum results to return per page, 1-50. Default 20. Example: 10.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging. Default 0. Example: 20 returns the second page when limit is 20.

name: list_conversations
